featured_reviews.name: Ketan Chothe
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located conveniently near Maxus Mall in Bhayander West, Aakhri Pasta offers a decent dining experience for pasta lovers. The menu features a variety of pasta dishes, from classic marinara to more unique options, catering to different tastes. The ambiance is casual, making it a nice spot for a quick meal or a laid-back hangout with friends.

One highlight is the jamun juice, which is very good and a refreshing complement to the meal. However, be aware that seating is limited, so it might get crowded during peak hours. While the flavors are generally solid, the portion sizes could be more generous for the price. Service is friendly, though it can be a bit slow. Overall, Aakhri Pasta is a solid choice if you're in the mood for a pasta fix, but don't expect anything too extraordinary.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul kapadia
featured_reviews.review_text: I visited Apsara Ice Creams last week and I was amazed by their variety of flavours and quality of ice creams. They have been serving in Mumbai since 1971 and they use fresh buffalo milk and natural ingredients to make their ice creams. I tried their **Belgian Bite** flavour, which was rich and creamy with chunks of chocolate. It was so delicious that I finished the whole tub by myself! I also tried their **Guava Glory** flavour, which was a unique combination of guava ice cream with masala salt. It reminded me of my childhood when I used to eat guava with the same masala. The ice cream was refreshing and tangy, and I loved the contrast of flavours. Apsara Ice Creams also has some other interesting flavours like **Pani Puri**, **Ferrero Rocher**, **Kulfi**, **Falooda**, Sorbet and more. They also have zero added sugar options for health-conscious customers. The prices are reasonable and the service is friendly and fast. The ambience is simple and clean, and they have seating arrangements for customers who want to enjoy their ice creams at the outlet. I would highly recommend Apsara Ice Creams to anyone who loves ice cream and wants to try something different. They have something for everyone, whether you like fruity, chocolaty, nutty or spicy flavours. Apsara Ice Creams is truly Mumbai's finest.

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Gajera
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a great experience at Take and Treat! The ambience is peaceful and well-maintained, ideal for family dinners or casual meals.🍾🤤

Their soya chaap is hands down the best item — delicious, tender, and seasoned with authentic masala. The option to order half or full is perfect for managing portions. 🍕🍻

The quantity is generous, and you definitely get your money’s worth. Every dish tastes fresh and rich in flavour without being overly spicy. The staff is polite, and the service is quick. Prices are super affordable, which makes it a go-to spot for everyday dining. Coffee is smooth and aromatic, and the lemon tea is soothing after a spicy meal. 🫶🏻

The overall vibe is homely and comfortable.
If you love authentic North Indian-style flavours and want something light on the pocket, this place won’t disappoint. Definitely recommending it to friends!🤟🤟

featured_reviews.name: Vinit Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Take and Treat is a hidden gem for food lovers looking for great taste at affordable rates.
The ambience is simple yet clean, giving a cozy local restaurant vibe. The staff is attentive and ensures your food is served hot and fresh.
Their soya chaap is the star — soft, flavorful, and perfectly cooked, with both half and full portions available.
You can really taste the authenticity in their spices and preparation. The rest of the menu is also impressive, with decent variety and generous portions.
Every dish feels like it’s made with care, not rushed. The rates are pocket-friendly, making it perfect for students and working people. The coffee is creamy and comforting, while the lemon tea is refreshing after a heavy meal.
It’s rare to find such quality food at this price. Great for both dine-in and takeaway — Take and Treat truly lives up to its name!

They mess up sometimes like we ordered a jain dish and they made it non-jain which we found out after taking a bite. Saying they forgot. And sometimes they forget to prepare a dish totally. Once ordered something and they totally forgot the order but was added in the bill and another time we had to remind multiple times to finally get our dish was a simple nachos order.
